0.reason: the suite's isolation fixtures place every helper git call in a temporary repository, and the 193-file population at the merge candidate covers all 121 importers; a test aiming the helper at a real checkout is a test defect the population would surface

findings.text: follow-on: the scrub makes the worker git shim transparent for every git call of the 121 test modules that import this helper, so a mutating verb any of them aims at a repository other than its own throwaway would no longer be refused; the docstring's justification that every test repository is a throwaway is asserted rather than enforced.

justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/helpers/git.py:23 carries the run-identity scrub and tests/test_..._once.py:29 calls that helper in place of the local one, which are the two asks resume-2 grants.
